title: Why “indemnité” is trending in FR: 500+ searches, the facts (October 09, 2026)
description: “indemnité” is trending in FR with 500+ searches reported by Google. The verified coverage behind the spike, from JeChange and 2 more.

sections.heading: What is trending: “indemnité”
paragraphs: “indemnité” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for FR (snapshot taken 2026-10-09T09:03:32+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 500 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from JeChange, Linfo.re, Service Public. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “Accidents du travail et maladies professionnelles : baisse du plafond servant au calcul des indemnités journalières” — Service Public
“Dès le 15 octobre, les indemnités journalières en cas d’arrêt de travail seront versées pendant 1 an maximum” — Linfo.re
“Accident du travail : dès le 1er novembre, la Sécu plafonne les indemnités journalières à 1,8 Smic” — JeChange

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Fri, 9 Oct 2026 00:50:00 -0700. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-10-09T09:03:32+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-10-09T09:04:32+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.

faq.a: Google's Trending Now feed links the spike to coverage from JeChange, Linfo.re, Service Public. The associated headlines are: “Accidents du travail et maladies professionnelles : baisse du plafond servant au calcul des indemnités journalières” (Service Public); “Dès le 15 octobre, les indemnités journalières en cas d’arrêt de travail seront versées pendant 1 an maximum” (Linfo.re); “Accident du travail : dès le 1er novembre, la Sécu plafonne les indemnités journalières à 1,8 Smic” (JeChange).
Google reports at least 500 searches in FR as of the feed snapshot. This is a published lower bound, not an exact count.
This snapshot covers FR. The same term may trend differently in other regions.
